title: Field Ecologist: Sampling the Meadow
niche: Biology and research methods (ecology sampling, bias and uncertainty)
audience: Grades 9–12 biology/environmental science, first-year undergraduates in research methods or ecology labs
summary: Design a sampling plan for a realistic 100 m × 100 m meadow, place quadrats under a time budget, identify and count five botanically plausible species, then see the meadow's true population and discover how your design choices biased your estimate — with a 1,000-sample re-sampling simulator and a survey-sampling transfer task.

poster.alt: Grass-level view across a meadow under a grey overcast sky: two white 2 m quadrat frames among yellow-flowered plants, blue sedges and pale bunchgrass on mottled soil, with shrubs, trees and green hills on the horizon
